name: What are the benefits of choosing a lever faucet over a knob-style faucet?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of choosing a lever faucet over a knob-style faucet?

acceptedAnswer.text: Lever faucets offer several advantages over traditional knob-style faucets. They are generally easier to operate, especially for individuals with limited dexterity, as they require less force to turn on and off. The single-handle design allows for precise temperature and flow control with one hand. Additionally, lever faucets often have a more contemporary aesthetic and can be easier to clean, as there are fewer crevices for grime to accumulate compared to separate hot and cold knobs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Lever faucets are easier to operate, offer precise temperature control, have a modern look, and are generally simpler to clean than knob-style faucets.
